roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR v0.4.9 for aortic-valve/stenosis MR: primary IVW, Egger slope/intercept, weighted median and simple/weighted modes, with Cochran Q. Instruments used non-cMRI GWAS, genome-wide significance and in-sample LD clumping.
roles.required_caution: Reported historical defaults are not current defaults. Author preparation, in-sample LD, selection and exact executed runtime remain unqualified; the modern native component supplies neither modes nor clumping.

roles.usage_summary: Used v0.5.6 for cis-eQTL/pQTL MR: Wald ratios for single instruments and IVW for multiple instruments, followed by separate coloc. Bidirectional trait/DCM discovery used weighted median, expanded as WM in Results, followed by Egger slope/intercept filters.
roles.required_caution: Keep QTL and trait-screen roles, separate correction families, PLINK clumping, coloc and CAUSE distinct. The linked custom pipeline is not executed here; its paper-executed commit and complete preparation are not established.

roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR to assess PUD/subtype associations with gastric cancer, using 23 independent East Asian instruments from a sample-overlap-avoiding meta-analysis and excluding F below ten. Separate MR-PRESSO corrected pleiotropic outliers.
roles.required_caution: The TwoSampleMR edition and precise estimator are unstated in this source paragraph. MR-PRESSO, exposure meta-analysis and power calculations remain separate providers/steps; do not invent a default estimator.

roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR for EUR CanUD follow-up after genetic-correlation/polygenic-overlap selection, with MR Egger to investigate horizontal pleiotropy.
roles.required_caution: Edition and exact function/options are not stated. The source names five candidate traits, removes one, but says three remain; preserve the unresolved count discrepancy rather than repairing it.

roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR for MDD-subtype/health-outcome IVW and sensitivity analyses including median/mode, Egger intercept/slope and Q; reported F strength and BH adjustment. Added separate MR-PRESSO and an I-squared/SIMEX procedure.
roles.required_caution: Preserve the I-squared 0.6/0.8 reporting rules, sample-overlap caveat and provider boundaries. Exact edition and F/I-squared functions are unstated; SIMEX and MR-PRESSO are not qualified by the native component.

roles.usage_summary: Reported v0.5.6 for MetS-to-outcome TSMR using UKB-excluded exposure data, default-described LD clumping and allele harmonization. Excluded palindromic/absent instruments and validated using MGI.
roles.required_caution: Retain the reported 0.5-percent MAF wording without silently resolving its filter direction. The estimator is not named in these paragraphs. Clumping, harmonization and cohort preparation are outside the native statistics component.

roles.usage_summary: Declared TwoSampleMR v0.5.7 among software used. Results describe an MR comparison alongside eQTL/pQTL colocalization, but these selected paragraphs do not attribute a specific estimator/function to the package.
roles.required_caution: Treat this as a positive software declaration with unresolved operation-level attribution. Do not assign an estimator or equate MR with colocalization. Linked author code and complete supplementary preparation are not executed or qualified.

roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR study summary data, reported default preprocessing/harmonization and genome-wide significant independent instruments without additional LD filtering. Tested IVW, weighted-median sensitivity and Cochran Q, with different reported significance cutoffs.
roles.required_caution: Edition and exact online resources/options are unreported. Do not add an extra LD filter or replace the specified IVW/median thresholds. The native component accepts prepared vectors and retrieves no study data.

roles.usage_summary: Listed TwoSampleMR and MendelianRandomization among analysis packages. TEMR simulations compare IVW, Egger, simple/weighted medians and modes, with bootstrap coverage assessment.
roles.required_caution: The exact provider/function attribution of each comparator and TwoSampleMR edition are not established. TEMR is a separate method; do not credit its trans-ethnic model or all comparators to TwoSampleMR or this native component.

roles.usage_summary: Used v0.5.7 with cartilage eQTL exposures and knee-osteoarthritis outcomes, LD clumping and F above ten. Used single-IV Wald, multi-IV IVW/median, Egger with more than three independent IVs, Q, and FDR on Wald/IVW results.
roles.required_caution: Keep author selection distinct from function minimum-SNP guards; the source component does not create a two-SNP median. LDlinkR proxy search is separate. Preserve the stricter author Egger instrument threshold and historical edition.

roles.usage_summary: Used TwoSampleMR for plasma-protein/PCOS cis-MR: single-pQTL Wald or multiple-pQTL IVW, BH follow-up, Egger, weighted median and simple/weighted modes. Used separate overlap-bias assessment and MR-PRESSO.
roles.required_caution: Edition and full settings are unreported. Effect-scale/exponentiation choices must be explicit; native b is not automatically an odds ratio. Modes, external bias calculations and MR-PRESSO remain outside the native scope.

roles.usage_summary: Used v0.5.7 for bidirectional SNP-based mediator/trait MR, IVW with at least two instruments and simple mode, weighted median and weighted mode sensitivity. Reported PLINK clumping, HLA/frequency exclusions, Steiger filtering and 54-test correction.
roles.required_caution: CNVs are not the instruments. Preserve the reported Steiger Z at most -1.96 and both GWAS/PLINK threshold declarations. Citation-adjacent 31 is not part of version 0.5.7. Graphing R4.3.1 differs from reported MR-pipeline R4.2.1.

roles.usage_summary: Used v0.6.8 clump_data for sleep IV selection at the reported 1e-5 threshold and harmonise_data for exposure/outcome alignment. Appendix MVMR preparation also used harmonise_data and mv_harmonise_data.
roles.required_caution: These are selection/harmonization roles, not proof that TwoSampleMR performed the robust MV-IVW or conditional F calculations. Those belong to separate providers, including MVMR v0.4.1. APM shrinkage and these preparation functions are not implemented by the native statistics component.

roles.usage_summary: Reported TwoSampleMR for tissue-specific GPGE medication/drug-gene target proxy analyses derived from S-PrediXcan, retaining the reported instrument p threshold of 0.05.
roles.required_caution: Edition, estimator and complete input-unit/independence preparation remain unreported. Do not replace the threshold with genome-wide significance, treat gene identifiers as prepared SNPs automatically, or claim drug-effect/whole-paper reproduction.
